description:
About the Scholarship

Mundus MAPP is the Erasmus Mundus master in public policy coordinated by Central European University with partner institutes across Europe. The financial-aid round closes on 1 December 2026, while self-funded applicants can apply until 15 April 2027 (non-EU) or 1 July 2027 (EU).

OpportunityMundus MAPP – Erasmus Mundus Master in Public Policy
HostMundus MAPP Consortium (CEU)
LocationBudapest (multi-country mobility), Hungary
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships in the financial-aid round:
Application Deadline1 December 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Mundus MAPP is the Erasmus Mundus master in public policy coordinated by Central European University with partner institutes across Europe. The financial-aid round closes on 1 December 2026, while self-funded applicants can apply until 15 April 2027 (non-EU) or 1 July 2027 (EU).

Programme Highlights

  • CEU-led policy school curriculum with quantitative methods emphasis
  • Early financial-aid deadline (1 December 2026) plus long self-funded windows
  • Two-year mobility with professional internship options
  • Graduates in governments, think tanks, international organisations and consultancy

Who Should Apply

Graduates in economics, political science, law, public administration and related fields with policy interest; strong analytical writing matters in the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships in the financial-aid round: tuition coverage plus a stipend for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the Mundus MAPP admissions page; if you need funding, submit before 1 December 2026. Key deadline information: 1 December 2026 (financial aid round). Non-EU self-funded: 15 April 2027; EU self-funded: 1 July 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Mundus MAPP Consortium (CEU)

The Mundus MAPP consortium is coordinated by Central European University and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Public Policy with European partner universities and policy schools.

Official website: https://www.mundusmapp.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
